listing.name: Waku Waku 7 (Neo Geo) / Waku-Waku-7-Recomp (omegakatana92)
listing.summary: Native static recompilation of Waku Waku 7 (Neo Geo MVS/AES) built on NeoGeoRecomp. The 68000 program is translated to C and runs against a modeled MVS board with LSPC video, palettes, raster effects, Z80/YM2610 audio, real MVS BIOS boot and SDL2 controllers. Windows x64 and Steam Deck AppImage builds; no ROMs or BIOS included.
